title: Komga Comic Reader for iPhone & Android | Sutra
description: Connect Sutra to Komga on iPhone or Android. Browse your comic library and read supported CBZ files, with Pro and streaming requirements explained.
h1: Read your Komga comics on iPhone and Android
intro: Sutra connects to Komga so you can browse and read your self-hosted comic library on iOS or Android. Komga access and full CBZ reading require Sutra Pro, a one-time purchase per platform.
benefits: Browse Komga libraries from Sutra using your server address and account credentials.
Read full CBZ comics with Sutra Pro and use panel-by-panel reading on supported content.
Reading progress syncs with Komga; server permissions and network reachability apply.
steps: Make sure your Komga server is reachable from the phone or tablet.
In Komga, use an account with access to the library. Enable the Page Streaming permission if you want page-by-page streaming.
In Sutra, choose Add Library, enter the bare server address without an OPDS path, then sign in with the Komga account.
Open a CBZ comic. If streaming is unavailable, Sutra can use the full-download path.
limitations: Komga and full CBZ access require Sutra Pro. A limited preview may be available. Pro is purchased separately through each platform's store.
Streaming requires the Komga account's Page Streaming permission and a supported server setup; otherwise download the complete file.
CBR archives and DRM-protected files are not supported.

faq.q: Does Sutra work with Komga on iPhone and Android?
faq.a: Sutra supports Komga on iOS and Android. Komga access requires Sutra Pro on the platform where you use it.

faq.q: How do I connect to Komga?
faq.a: In Sutra, choose Add Library, enter the bare Komga server address (not a full OPDS catalog URL), then sign in with an account that can access the library.

faq.q: Why is Komga page streaming unavailable?
faq.a: The Komga account used by Sutra must have Page Streaming permission and library access. Without that permission, use the complete CBZ download instead.

faq.q: Is Komga support included in the free version?
faq.a: No. Komga access and full CBZ reading require Sutra Pro. A limited CBZ preview may be available before purchase.

faq.q: Does Pro transfer between iOS and Android?
faq.a: No. Apple and Google purchases are separate; a Pro purchase on one platform does not carry over to the other.

transcript: On an iPhone, a comic's details screen appears. The reader opens the comic without first downloading the full book, dismisses introductory navigation tips, and moves from the cover through several streamed pages. The server is not identified in the recording.
